dataset_id: formId=350,class_type=Debt,ed_code=External Debt - ED of banks and organizations controlled by government,period=quarter,type=USD mln
indicator_name: External Debt: Banks and Organisations Controlled by Government (quasi-state)
description: Внешний долг банков и организаций, контролируемых государством (квазигосударственный сектор)
methodology: USD million, end of quarter. External debt of banks and organisations CONTROLLED BY THE GOVERNMENT (over 50 % state ownership: Samruk-Kazyna, Baiterek, KMG, KTZ and their subsidiaries) -- the external part of quasi-state debt, the only machine-readable measure of it (Minfin publishes no quasi-state debt table; total quasi-state debt, external and internal, appears only in the Supreme Audit Chamber's annual report: 29.19 trn KZT at end-2025). Public ED (government and NBK) plus this = EXTERNAL_DEBT_PUBLIC_SECTOR. From 2014-04-01.
